test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'TALENT' is written as 'VXNBPQ', and 'HORDIN' is written as 'JLTAKK'. How will 'AKRPQB' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

'TALENT' is written as 'VXNBPQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1339e6c9fba84cce5ef407763b64afe143ed3e66361a464a22e1132688d0575a.png] 

And,

'HORDIN' is written as 'JLTAKK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3f80cbdf19413792f665313c523aab04c7f6ca85ebcd43cbbe91fa3ea8c9545.png] 

Similarly,

'AKRPQB' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a86512d758161dd78b02b941a78677d5c45b695dbee030efea2a6eb7b883b0d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CHTMSY".**
